name: Citizen · Sign In
note: Design intent = SMILE-Transgender unified login (SMILE-Transgender | Citizen, node 9379:115794). Build = tg-user-dev citizen portal. Findings are dev-fixable fidelity gaps against that design frame.

findings.figma: The login card leads with a three-way role switcher — Citizen · Admin · Garima Greh — with Citizen active.
findings.live: The citizen build renders no role tabs; the card opens straight into the 'Log In to your account' heading.
findings.fix: Restore the Citizen / Admin / Garima Greh role-tab switcher at the top of the login card, per the design frame.

findings.figma: Design offers a single Email field under 'or sign in with credentials', then a Send OTP button.
findings.live: Build inserts a second 'Mobile Number' field (with its own 'or' divider) below the Email Id field — a field absent from the design.
findings.fix: Align to the design's single-field pattern, or update the design frame if the Mobile Number entry is a deliberate addition.

findings.figma: Heading reads 'Log in to your account' (sentence case).
findings.live: Build renders 'Log In to your account' — 'In' is capitalised.
findings.fix: Match the design's sentence-case heading: 'Log in to your account'.
